title: ProActions Blocks Definitions Schema
description: Reusable block definitions for scoped constants, vars, flows, and scripts.

constants.description: Static values accessible via scoped namespaces (global.constants.*, section.constants.*, local.constants.*, imports.<alias>.constants.*).

vars.description: Lazy template variables resolved at runtime from scoped namespaces.

flows.description: Reusable flow definitions callable via CALL_FLOW/CALL_TEMPLATE ref.
